subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can name devices like laptop, e-reader and headphones.
I can say how the WOW! Team uses technology.
I can say how technology helps us at home and at school.

tf.s: A laptop is a small computer you can carry.
tf.why: Yes! You can take a laptop with you.

tf.s: You type a password to open your laptop or an app.
tf.why: Correct! A password keeps it safe.

tf.s: Headphones let everyone in the room hear your music.
tf.why: With headphones, only you hear the music.

tf.s: An e-reader is a device for reading books.
tf.why: Right! You read books on an e-reader.

tf.s: A printer is a device for taking photos.
tf.why: A printer puts words and pictures on paper.

tf.s: Arlo loves watching sport on TV.
tf.why: Yes! That's in Arlo's blog post.

tf.s: Reem's smartphone takes better photos than her digital camera.
tf.why: Her digital camera takes better photos.

tf.s: Sultan sends his homework to the school homework website.
Julia uses headphones because she doesn't have a speaker.
tf.why: Yes, so nobody else hears her music.

tf.s: A speaker has a screen for watching videos.
tf.why: A speaker plays sound; it doesn't need a screen.

boxes.q: A device that puts your work on paper:

hunt.q: Secret word to open an app

mcq.q: Which list has three devices with screens?

o: something you type to open your laptop or app
mcq.why: A password keeps your device safe.

mcq.q: What do we call laptops, smartphones and e-readers?

o: a place on the internet with information
mcq.why: You visit websites on the internet.

mcq.q: You want to listen to music on the bus without others hearing. What do you use?
mcq.why: Headphones keep music just for you.

mcq.q: Which two devices can you use to read books?
mcq.why: You can read books on screens.

o: I use my laptop to do my homework.
I use my headphones to print my homework.
I use my speaker to read books.
I use my printer to take photos.
mcq.why: A laptop is good for homework.

mcq.q: Why does Reem use her digital camera for photos?
o: It takes better photos than her smartphone.
mcq.why: The digital camera takes better photos.

mcq.q: Which is a good answer to the WOW! Question "How can technology help us at school?"
o: We can find information for projects and watch videos to learn.
We don't need teachers or books.
We can play games all day in class.
mcq.why: Technology helps us learn and find information.

mcq.q: Julia doesn't have a speaker. What is the best way for her to listen to music?
mcq.why: Headphones play music without a speaker.
